members.gloss: given to excess in consumption of especially food or drink
members.tone: Names one of the seven deadly sins; the excess is a moral failure, not an appetite.

members.gloss: given to gross intemperance in eating or drinking
members.tone: Formal and disgusted, and about drink as much as food.

members.gloss: suffering from excessive eating or drinking
members.tone: Describes the sick aftermath rather than the appetite - more pitiable than blamed.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: Too bookish to wound - the oddity of the word softens the greed into comedy.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: Literary and dry - hunger stated as if from a distance.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: The hunger is predatory - devouring as though by seizure.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: Predatory and archaic-sounding, as of a beast that has not eaten.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: Hunger at full strength, and no fault in it.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: Appetite at full stretch - the eating is hard to satisfy.

members.gloss: devouring or craving food in great quantities
members.tone: Adds hunger to the manner of eating; it watches the food the way a predator would.

members.gloss: wanting to eat or drink more than one can reasonably consume
members.tone: The everyday charge for appetite: wanting more than one can use.

members.gloss: resembling swine; coarsely gluttonous or greedy
members.tone: Compares the person to a pig outright, with none of the softening *piggy* has.

members.gloss: resembling swine; coarsely gluttonous or greedy
members.tone: Greed and coarseness laid on with the farm animal - the comparison does the insulting.

members.gloss: resembling swine; coarsely gluttonous or greedy
members.tone: Diminutive, and small enough to carry no real anger.

members.gloss: resembling swine; coarsely gluttonous or greedy
members.tone: Formal and cold - the comparison to swine delivered clinically, which sharpens it.

members.gloss: resembling swine; coarsely gluttonous or greedy
members.tone: Broader than eating: it condemns the whole manner of the person.

members.gloss: unwilling to spend (money, time, resources, etc.)
members.tone: The plain word. Its mirror image is *thrifty*, which praises the identical behaviour.

members.gloss: unwilling to spend (money, time, resources, etc.)
members.tone: Names the missing virtue rather than the present vice, which makes it the politer complaint.

members.gloss: (used of sums of money) so small in amount as to deserve contempt
members.tone: Said of the sum, not the person - an amount so small it insults whoever receives it.

members.gloss: (used of sums of money) so small in amount as to deserve contempt
members.tone: Of the amount, not the giver - a sum small enough to read as an insult.

members.gloss: embarrassingly stingy
members.tone: Stinginess as a public embarrassment - the shame is the point.

members.gloss: embarrassingly stingy
members.tone: Regional American and dismissive.

members.gloss: embarrassingly stingy
members.tone: Stinginess with the embarrassment built in - the cheapness shows.

members.gloss: giving or spending with reluctance
members.tone: Formal and disdainful: economy pursued past the point of dignity.

members.gloss: giving or spending with reluctance
members.tone: Euphemistic. *Close with money* is what you say when you do not want to say stingy.

members.gloss: giving or spending with reluctance
members.tone: A euphemism - stinginess softened into mere 'closeness' with money.

members.gloss: giving or spending with reluctance
members.tone: Pictures the act, and the smallness of the coin does the condemning.

members.gloss: giving or spending with reluctance
members.tone: Stinginess as thinness - giving kept as lean as the frame.

members.gloss: unwilling to part with money
members.tone: The hand that will not open - refusal made physical.

members.gloss: unwilling to part with money
members.tone: Harder than 'closefisted' by a shade - the fist has closed tighter.

members.gloss: unwilling to part with money
members.tone: The most vivid of the fists - the hand is shut and stays shut.

members.gloss: petty or reluctant in giving or spending
members.tone: The money was given - resentfully, which is what makes it worse than refusal for some.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: The plain moral word - a direct accusation, nothing clinical in it.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: It names a doctrine as much as a habit, which cools the accusation.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: The same word with an extra syllable, and no extra force.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: The clinical-sounding member of the family - reads as diagnosis more than accusation.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: Softer than *selfish* - it describes where attention sits rather than what was taken.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: The British spelling, identical in force.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: Adds calculation: the generous-looking act had a private purpose.

members.gloss: concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
members.tone: The same charge, aimed at a career rather than a single act.

members.gloss: characteristic of those having an inflated idea of their own importance
members.tone: Vanity rather than greed - about talking of oneself, not taking for oneself.

members.gloss: characteristic of those having an inflated idea of their own importance
members.tone: Flat contempt for self-importance - the inflation is visible to everyone but its owner.

members.gloss: characteristic of those having an inflated idea of their own importance
members.tone: A clinical diagnosis used as an insult, which is what makes it land so hard.

members.gloss: characteristic of those having an inflated idea of their own importance
members.tone: The literal compound turned accusation - love pointed at the wrong object.

members.gloss: absorbed in your own interests or thoughts etc
members.tone: Inattentive rather than grasping; the harm is what gets overlooked.

members.gloss: absorbed in your own interests or thoughts etc
members.tone: The same forgivable fault, and the milder of the two phrasings.

members.gloss: marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful
members.tone: Praise for modesty worn willingly - the opposite of arrogance, and credited for it.

members.gloss: subdued or brought low in condition or status
members.tone: Not modesty at all: something was done to this person and it worked.

members.gloss: subdued or brought low in condition or status
members.tone: The heaviest word in the family, and always about defeat rather than character.

members.gloss: subdued or brought low in condition or status
members.tone: Brought down and knowing it - the word reports the defeat and expects it to be admitted.

members.gloss: subdued or brought low in condition or status
members.tone: Requires an audience - the lowering had to be seen to count.

members.gloss: subdued or brought low in condition or status
members.tone: Status, not disposition - fallen in condition rather than in spirits.

members.gloss: humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness
members.tone: Mildness that shades into submission - the virtue and the weakness share the word.

members.gloss: humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness
members.tone: Gentleness of manner with no claim about the will behind it.

members.gloss: humble in spirit or manner; suggesting retiring mildness or even cowed submissiveness
members.tone: Approving of a retiring manner - mildness as virtue, though the gloss lets it border on submissiveness.

members.gloss: soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
members.tone: The plain word for soiling - direct, and mildly reproachful.

members.gloss: soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
members.tone: Clinical and euphemistic - a softer word chosen to avoid 'dirty'.

members.gloss: soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
members.tone: Condemns the thing as unfit rather than merely dirty.

members.gloss: limp and soiled as if dragged in the mud
members.tone: Pitiable rather than blamed - the rain did this, not the person.

members.gloss: limp and soiled as if dragged in the mud
members.tone: A form of 'bedraggled', with the same sympathy for whatever got dragged through the mud.

members.gloss: made dirty or foul
members.tone: Formal and disgusted, and it implies an agent: someone fouled this.

members.gloss: made dirty or foul
members.tone: The plainer form of 'befouled' - the same dirtying stated without relish.

members.gloss: thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
members.tone: Heavy, literary dirt - ingrained past any quick washing.

members.gloss: thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
members.tone: Descriptive and physical; grime is a fact about a surface, not a fault.

members.gloss: thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
members.tone: Mild enough to be affectionate - dirt of the kind a child comes home in.

members.gloss: thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
members.tone: Informal and unimpressed - dirt that has been let settle in for good.

members.gloss: thickly covered with ingrained dirt or soot
members.tone: Dated - grime so thick it has worked into the thing itself.

members.gloss: soiled with dirt or soot
members.tone: Literal soot in this sense, and one of a great many senses this word carries.

members.gloss: soiled with dirt or soot
members.tone: Soot rather than filth - the dirt is superficial and comes off.

members.gloss: infested with bugs
members.tone: Disgust with a squirm in it - not merely dirty but inhabited.

members.gloss: refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style
members.tone: Restraint doing the work - the highest praise in the family, and the quietest.

members.gloss: affecting extreme elegance in dress and manner
members.tone: Elegance turned into a project, and visibly so.

members.gloss: affecting extreme elegance in dress and manner
members.tone: Vanity of dress as a character trait - the dandy made an adjective.

members.gloss: affecting extreme elegance in dress and manner
members.tone: Beyond dandified: the appearance has crowded out everything else.

members.gloss: elegant and sumptuous
members.tone: A marketing word more than a compliment - it still sounds like packaging.

members.gloss: elegant and sumptuous
members.tone: The spaced spelling, slightly more formal than 'deluxe'.

members.gloss: elegant and sumptuous
members.tone: Clipped and fashion-trade; it names a look rather than a quality.

members.gloss: characterized by elegance or refinement or accomplishment
members.tone: In this sense, genuine praise - refinement noticed and credited.

members.gloss: pretentiously elegant
members.tone: Pretension built in - it announces a rank rather than showing one.

members.gloss: pretentiously elegant
members.tone: Sneers at the elegance as put on - the height is affectation.

members.gloss: lavishly elegant and refined
members.tone: Praise at the limit, and it implies the observer noticed every detail.

members.gloss: lavishly elegant and refined
members.tone: Rare and studied. Whether that is praise depends on how hard the search shows.

members.gloss: luxuriously elegant
members.tone: Luxury with a raised eyebrow: elegance that announces its own price.

members.gloss: polished and well-groomed; showing sophisticated elegance
members.tone: Grooming and polish rather than taste; it is about the finish.

members.gloss: polished and well-groomed; showing sophisticated elegance
members.tone: Admiring: polish so complete the effort disappears.

members.gloss: enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
members.tone: Endurance with an even temper - the temper is what distinguishes it from mere waiting.

members.gloss: quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness
members.tone: Patience aimed at work, and it praises the steadiness rather than the result.

members.gloss: quietly and steadily persevering especially in detail or exactness
members.tone: The same steadiness against resistance; it presumes there was reason to stop.

members.gloss: patiently bearing continual wrongs or trouble
members.tone: Praise for the bearing - the wrongs are continual and the patience holds.

members.gloss: patiently bearing continual wrongs or trouble
members.tone: Faintly complaining on the person's behalf - the trouble should have ended by now.

members.gloss: showing patient and unruffled self-control and restraint under adversity; slow to retaliate or express resentment
members.tone: Restraint under provocation, when retaliation was available and was declined.

members.gloss: showing patient and unruffled self-control and restraint under adversity; slow to retaliate or express resentment
members.tone: Patience under provocation, named in its most formal register.

members.gloss: showing the capacity for endurance
members.tone: Endurance credited as a virtue - hardship borne without complaint.

members.gloss: showing the capacity for endurance
members.tone: A construction rather than a word - *patient of delay* - and formal to the point of stiffness.

members.gloss: eager to investigate and learn or learn more (sometimes about others' concerns)
members.tone: Approving of the mind and faintly wary of the manner - the gloss admits both.

members.gloss: showing curiosity
members.tone: Praise for a child, and a hint of too many questions for an adult.

members.gloss: showing curiosity
members.tone: Curiosity held at a distance - it wonders and weighs rather than asks.

members.gloss: showing curiosity
members.tone: The plainest form: the questions are being asked, and nothing is implied about why.

members.gloss: showing curiosity
members.tone: Curiosity with the wonder still in it, and no agenda attached.

members.gloss: offensively curious or inquisitive
members.tone: The everyday accusation, and it is about other people's business specifically.

members.gloss: offensively curious or inquisitive
members.tone: The same accusation as 'nosy' - curiosity that has crossed into prying.

members.gloss: offensively curious or inquisitive
members.tone: Names the act rather than the character - the person is doing it right now.

members.gloss: offensively curious or inquisitive
members.tone: Informal and slightly comic, which takes some of the sting out.

members.gloss: showing excessive curiosity
members.tone: The formal way of saying nosy, and it grants that curiosity itself was fine.
